ownerDirective.interpretation: The Governor delegates the B07 construction, hydrology, lower-route, safety/recovery, and release-operator roles to the implementation team. This authority permits only the finite lower pressure-gallery transaction: liner and bulkhead before core clearance, then a closed hatch/ladder. It does not authorize a surface opening, egress, public route, or upper B07 connection.

mvpBoundary.included: Only MP05-B07-LOWER-PRESSURE-GALLERY-01, its exact three packages, and its scoped guarded-release kernel.
mvpBoundary.exclusionRule: This authority does not open R09J or R07J caps, the upper stair, any exterior receiver, B08/B09, a fluid outfall, transport, public access, staff through-routing, or emergency egress.

hardSafetyKernel.rule: Independent structural QA must bind complete canonical block states, exact target bijection, package disjointness, outer-liner-first order, and forward/rollback inversion.
Every live invocation captures a fresh immutable complete source snapshot and passes exact forward source preflight in package order.
Every forward and rollback operation file must pass strict-noop parser validation before mutation.
The exact target and finite interaction halo must be clear of block entities and fresh same-moment live entities before execution.
Forward execution must be strict-noop and journaled. Any failure triggers the exact inverse for the partial and already-committed package set in reverse order.
A fresh immutable post snapshot, exact rollback poststate preflight, retained-fluid boundary comparison, and release-specific pressure-gallery QA are mandatory before an as-built claim.

operationalControls.scopeLocalFailureRule: A failed fluid, gravity, entity, source, or route check blocks only this exact transaction and cannot be used to reopen a cap or restore an obsolete global B07 hold.
